metadata.description: Claude Code plugins, curated and shareable

plugins.name: notebooklm-connector
plugins.description: A plugin to manage NotebookLM notebooks and query them using integrated features.

plugins.name: toolbox
plugins.description: Personal utility commands and tools for Claude Code

plugins.name: vibeproxy-kit
plugins.description: State-aware VibeProxy alias manager for Claude Code. Discover VibeProxy state, choose backend-specific cc-* aliases, and rewrite only managed config and shell blocks without clobbering manual edits.

plugins.name: vision-powers
plugins.description: Analyze Claude Code plugins and visualize development artifacts as interactive HTML or diagram-enhanced markdown reports. Six skills: plugin-visual (local/installed/GitHub plugin audits with security + architecture), diff-visual (git diffs), doc-visual (markdown docs with Mermaid diagrams), fact-check (claim verification against code + git history), context-health-visual (environment health with skill-security scan and hook schema validation), report-manager (list/open/delete/search/refine). Every report supports --format md, --lang, and in-browser per-section feedback.

plugins.name: worktree-plus
plugins.description: Replaces Claude Code's built-in worktree — aligns with native git worktree where CC diverges (HEAD base, origin/* auto-tracking) and adds layers native lacks: .worktreeinclude/.worktreelink for gitignored files, upstream-aware removal guard, idempotent re-entry.

plugins.name: skill-creator-pro
plugins.description: Create, test, and iteratively improve Claude Code skills with the official lean coaching loop, an eval harness for benchmarking with variance analysis, and automated description-trigger optimization

plugins.name: codex-advisor
plugins.description: Double-check layer for the Official Codex plugin — wraps every Codex interaction with Claude's independent critical evaluation. Skills: setup, review, adversarial, rescue, verify, research, status, result, cancel. Every skill accepts --model/--effort via config.toml. Tested against codex@openai-codex 1.0.4 and Codex CLI 0.125 (gpt-5.5).

plugins.name: rubber-duck-tutor
plugins.description: Rubber duck tutor that combats rubber-stamping in AI-assisted workflows. Dedicated commands per phase (/duck-design, /duck-plan, /duck-verify, /duck-review, /duck-orient) plus /duck for auto-detect. Auto-hooks at plan creation, spec documents, PR/MR, and git push.

plugins.name: e2e-test-runner
plugins.description: Run E2E browser tests using natural language test definitions powered by Claude Code SDK and agent-browser with video recording

plugins.name: claw-mo
plugins.description: Manage mo markdown viewer sessions: autosync new Claude-written .md via PostToolUse hook, group-based organization, restart-on-up for fsnotify-miss recovery, file deep-linking, stdin pipe support, cmux browser integration, per-project watch patterns, port isolation

plugins.name: claw-mux
plugins.description: cmux terminal integration: terminal I/O, topology control, browser automation, markdown viewer, notifications
